title: Plain-text beta recipe
description: One reviewed recipe file (recipes/<slug>.yaml). All text is plain, single-line and rendered as text. recipes/validate.py also enforces normalization, the 20,000-character content cap and the file name.

slug.description: URL and file identity: lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens.

source.description: Optional plain-text source or credit. Never rendered as markup or a link.

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines in display order, one ingredient per entry.

instructions.description: Cooking steps in order; the entry position is the step number.

notes.description: Optional plain-text notes (yield, equipment, tips) in display order. Omit when empty.

line.description: Nonempty single line without control characters or surrounding whitespace.
